concept.title: If you have a flat tire (with spare tire)
concept.shortdesc: If you have a flat tire, you can use tools to replace it with a spare tire.

li.p: Driving on a flat tire causes permanent damage to the tire. Reinflating a tire after you drive on it while the tire is severely underinflated or flat may cause a blowout and a serious crash. Never attempt to reinflate a tire that has been driven on while severely underinflated or flat. In this case, replace the flat tire as soon as possible.
Changing a tire can be dangerous. To reduce the risk of serious injury or death, follow the instructions in this section when you change a tire.

note.p: When using the jack handle, be careful to stay clear of the flat end, as it has sharp edges that could cause cuts.
